exp1.description: Development of scalable enterprise web applications at a software house specialized in enterprise solutions. Full stack role between PHP/Node.js backend and Vue 3 frontend, with strong focus on code quality, API integration and modular architectures.
responsibilities: Backend design and development with PHP/Yii2, Node.js and TypeScript
Building dynamic interfaces with Vue 3
External API integration (WhatsApp, SMS, Email)
JWT authentication and role-based authorization (RBAC) implementation
API documentation with Swagger and testing with PHPUnit
Cross-team collaboration using Agile methodology for iterative releases

exp2.description: Development of the configuration wizard for omnichannel marketing campaigns, one of the platform's core tools. Management of the entire frontend cycle: component architecture, validations, state management and UX optimization for complex flows.
responsibilities: Advanced wizard to configure Email, SMS, WhatsApp and Phone campaigns
Reusable and scalable Vue 3 component architecture
State management with Pinia for multi-step flows
Dynamic form validation with Vee-Validate
Backend API integration for campaign management
Frontend performance tuning to reduce perceived latency

exp3.description: Development and refactoring of legacy backend applications for a company in the pension sector. Focus on code robustness, database optimization and collaboration with QA team for production release.
responsibilities: Backend application development and maintenance in Perl
Legacy code refactoring to improve readability and robustness
MySQL query optimization and database structure improvements
Design of reusable modules with technical documentation
Collaboration with QA and operations teams for deployment and monitoring

exp4.description: Design and development of the AI-driven conversational runtime, the most architecturally complex project of the platform. Based on Finite State Machines with XState v5 in a microservices architecture, it manages the entire execution logic of conversational flows.
responsibilities: Microservices architecture for AI conversational runtime
Dynamic compilation of Flow JSON into FSM with XState v5
Snapshot persistence and conversation resume on Redis
3-hash memory model with deterministic priority
Versioned runtime API exposure
40% response time reduction through microservices optimization

exp5.description: Integration of external communication channels into the enterprise platform and definition of API quality standards. Responsible for technical documentation and automated endpoint testing.
responsibilities: WhatsApp Business, SMS provider and transactional Email API integration
RESTful API documentation with Swagger/OpenAPI
Automated endpoint testing with PHPUnit
File and asset management on AWS S3
Internal standards definition for API quality and maintainability
API contract validation with Postman

exp6.description: Database performance optimization across the entire enterprise platform. Interventions on critical queries, indexing and caching that led to a 35% improvement in overall application performance.
responsibilities: Analysis and rewriting of critical SQL queries to reduce response times
35% performance improvement through PostgreSQL optimization
Caching layer implementation with Redis
Database schema refactoring for scalability
Zero-downtime migration management
Sybase database support in legacy contexts

exp7.description: Code quality oversight through automated testing integrated into the Agile cycle. Team reference for testing standards, code coverage and end-to-end quality assurance processes.
responsibilities: Unit and integration testing with PHPUnit
Frontend testing with Jest
API validation and testing with Swagger and Postman
Code coverage analysis and critical area identification
Test integration in CI/CD pipeline
Testing best practices definition for the team

exp8.description: User interface development for the enterprise platform with Vue 3. Focus on reusable components, smooth user experience and client-side performance.
responsibilities: Modular and reusable Vue 3 component development
Froala Editor integration for rich text functionality
State management with Pinia for multi-module applications
Responsive UI with Bootstrap
Bundle size optimization and asynchronous module loading
Pixel-perfect UI implementation in collaboration with designers

exp9.description: Application architecture and development processes oversight. Responsible for security, version control and Agile methodology in enterprise platform projects.
responsibilities: RESTful microservices implementation with Node.js and Express
Application security: JWT authentication and RBAC systems
Git repository management with GitLab and GitHub
Cloud storage and asset management with AWS S3
Agile/SCRUM process facilitation with Jira
Code review and technical team mentoring
